use_cases.name: Submit Training Request
use_cases.description: An employee submits a request to attend a training course.
use_cases.expected_results: The request appears in the manager's approval queue.
normal_flow: Employee opens the training request form
Employee fills in course name, date, and cost
alternative_flows: Employee saves the request as a draft
exceptions: Cost exceeds the employee's annual training budget

use_cases.name: Approve Training Request
use_cases.description: A manager approves or rejects a pending training request.
postconditions: Request status is updated to 'Approved' or 'Rejected'
use_cases.expected_results: The employee is notified of the decision.
normal_flow: Manager approves or rejects with a comment
exceptions: Request was withdrawn by the employee before decision
